reviewer.role: Independent AI visual reviewer; not the PR implementation agent
reviewer.review_independence: Separate assistant analysis of owner-supplied, manifest-verified final rendered artifacts

methods: Verified archive and manifest SHA-256 values in owner-private Vercel sandbox
Inspected actual final page images from Chromium, LibreOffice 24.2.7.2 and LibreOffice 26.2.6.3
Reviewed page composition in color render comparisons and lossless binary-ink page enlargements derived from original PNGs
Did not regenerate or alter original approved document source

findings: Two clean, substantially filled pages with no conspicuous stranded headings or bullets.
Name/contact hierarchy, section headings, engagement labels and bullet rhythm are readable and distinguishable.
Career groups do not visibly fragment across pages; bottom whitespace is reasonable.
Correctly displayed currency amounts; no visible stray Markdown escape characters.
non_blocking_notes: Minimal, ATS-oriented visual style rather than a heavily designed executive résumé.
Page 2 has no repeat name/page identifier; helpful for standalone printing, but not a material composition failure under the specified contract.

findings: Clear title and executive-summary hierarchy; section transitions consistently spaced.
Both numerical tables have aligned columns, visible row grouping and readable labels.
Narrative bullets and management-certification section remain on the same page without clipping or a stranded heading.
non_blocking_notes: Table styling is restrained; the underlying illustrative number format is a content decision, not a page-composition defect.

findings: Numbered clauses and nested subsection headings are consistently formatted.
Signature labels, representatives and dates are visibly grouped and remain in the page margins.
No partially blank second page, isolated signature block, clipped title or visibly anomalous line spacing.
non_blocking_notes: This is a visual-composition review only, not review of legal sufficiency or enforceability.

phase2_release_gate_recommendation: Eligible to record independent AI PAGE_COMPOSITION PASS, subject to owner acceptance of AI-review evidence and fresh exact-head qualification after integration with current main.
review_limitations: This is an independent AI visual assessment, not a licensed-design-professional or human review.
No native Microsoft Word rendering was inspected.
Image visual review cannot replace the existing mechanical source, font and security checks; those have separate evidence.
No cryptographic reviewer signing key is available. This record contains a self-attested reviewer attribution, not a digital signature.

attestation.statement: I inspected the artifact-hash-bound final page images of the private résumé, financial report, and business agreement across the three cited renderers and found no material PAGE_COMPOSITION defects. My independent visual verdict is PASS. This is not a release authorization.
